description: This file defines the Reward controller within the OpenCart e-commerce platform, responsible for managing reward points during checkout, including displaying reward info and saving user selections.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Controller class for handling reward points during checkout in the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays reward points information on the checkout page if the reward system is enabled.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the user's selected reward points, validating against available points and cart total, and returning a JSON response.
